title: One-step simulation from a release state
statement: Let $k,l$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let a placement consist of an injection from the $k$ source tape indices into the $l$ host tape indices and an exact selector for its occupied indices. Suppose source and host machines have transition functions related as follows: from the host release state, on every input symbol and tuple of host-tape symbols, the host transition is the placed action corresponding to the source transition at state $q$, with source tape symbols read at the placed indices. Then, for any host tape contents and head positions and any source configuration $c$ whose state is $q$, one host step from the placed configuration with its state replaced by the release state equals the placement of the source machine's next configuration.
hypotheses_covered: A placement with an injection and an exact selector

Transition agreement for all input symbols and host tape-symbol tuples
